# camundacluster_tenant (Resource)

A Camunda cluster tenant

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "camundacluster_tenant" "example" {
  tenant_id   = "my-tenant"
  name        = "My Tenant"
  description = "A tenant managed by Terraform"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the tenant.
- `tenant_id` (String) The unique ID for the tenant. Must be 256 characters or less. Can contain letters, numbers, `_`, `-`, `+`, `.`, `@`.

### Optional

- `description` (String) The description of the tenant.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique ID of a tenant (the tenant ID).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import camundacluster_tenant.example "my-tenant"
```
